description:
Return the full Polderchain Covenant: Axiom Zero, the seven Directives (each with the balance clause that keeps it from being absolute) and the rule for parking a deadlock with a human elder.
Use it to read or quote the Covenant. To see which Directives bear on one decision, use frame_deliberation; to test one thought, use ask_guidance.
Behavior: no key; writes nothing. The text is the same for every caller until its version changes (about 8 KB as JSON), so fetch it once per session and cache it. Limit: 120 calls per minute per address, 600 with a key, shared across all MCP calls; past it, an error with retry_after.
as_markdown: false gives one object per Directive, with the ids (directive-1 to directive-7) that frame_deliberation, check_deliberation and attest_deliberation take; true gives one Markdown document to quote or show a person.

as_markdown.description: false (default): structured JSON objects per Directive; true: the same text as one Markdown document, for quoting or display

name: get_covenant

outputSchema.description: the Covenant as JSON (default) or as {markdown} when as_markdown=true

manifests_as.description: how it shows up in practice

balance.description: the balance clause that stops it being absolute

markdown.description: present only when as_markdown=true: the whole Covenant as one Markdown document

title: Read the Covenant
